commands.serve: node space serve HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=0 CUSTOMWARE_PATH=<scratch>

server.port: 0 = ephemeral, URL printed as 'space server listening at http://127.0.0.1:<port>'

telemetry.auto_update: never at startup — 'space update' is an explicit CLI command only; electron-updater lives in packaging/desktop only, never in the thin server

env_switches.GIT_URL: unset — update remote falls back to local origin, never contacted by the adapter
env_switches.SPACE_GITHUB_TOKEN: unset — no GitHub auth header sent without it

telemetry.network: no outbound call at boot; proxy + update paths are user-initiated only
